question: A spring at Verinag is the source of ______ river in the northern part of India.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jhelum**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• **Jhelum river** origins in spring at **Verinag** in the **Pir Panjal **range of the Himalayas.

 
 
• It flows from the **Kashmir valley** and through the** Wular lake**.
 
• It is only the Himalayan river which **meanders in its youth stage**.
 
• It is one of the important **tributaries** of the** Indus river**.
 
• It joins the **Chenab** river near **Jhang in Pakistan**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a80b6eb91af964982f0610632bc28990eb3cfe96f08a8c2dee2aaa3abb23c38c.png] ​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 **River**
 **Origin**
 
 

 Indus
 Glacier near** Bokhar Chu** in Tibetian Plateau.
 
 

 Ganga
 **Gangotri** glacier near Gaumukh in the Uttarkashi, Uttarakhand
 
 

 Brahmaputra
 **Chemayungdung** glacier of the Kailash range near Mansarovar lake.
 
 

 Beas
 **Beas Kund **near Rohtang pass of Kullu hills, Himachal Pradesh.
 
 

 Ravi
 Rohtang pass in the **Kullu hills** of Himachal Pradesh.
 
 

 Chenab
 Formed by two streams,** the Chandra and the Bhaga** in Himachal Pradesh.
